keyEvents.text: Jobe Bellingham (Borussia Dortmund) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Ismael Saibari (Bayern Munich).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Bayern Munich. Nathaniel Brown replaces Ismael Saibari because of an injury.
Delay in match because of an injury Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich).
Substitution, Bayern Munich. Josip Stanisic replaces Serge Gnabry because of an injury.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Jonas Urbig (Bayern Munich).
Delay in match (Borussia Dortmund).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Bayern Munich 1, Borussia Dortmund 0. Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) right footed shot from the right side of the six yard box to the bottom right corner.
First Half ends, Bayern Munich 1, Borussia Dortmund 0.
Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Penalty missed! Still Bayern Munich 1, Borussia Dortmund 0. Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) hits the bar with a right footed shot.
Goal! Bayern Munich 1, Borussia Dortmund 1. Serhou Guirassy (Borussia Dortmund) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Carney Chukwuemeka.

Goal! Bayern Munich 2, Borussia Dortmund 1. Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Harry Kane with a headed pass following a corner.
Substitution, Borussia Dortmund. Marcel Sabitzer replaces Carney Chukwuemeka.
Substitution, Borussia Dortmund. Konstantinos Karetsas replaces Maximilian Beier.
Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Borussia Dortmund. Fábio Silva replaces Felix Nmecha.
Delay in match because of an injury Michael Olise (Bayern Munich).
Substitution, Bayern Munich. Lennart Karl replaces Michael Olise because of an injury.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Borussia Dortmund. Samuele Inácio replaces Jobe Bellingham.
Substitution, Borussia Dortmund. Julian Ryerson replaces Joane Gadou.

Goal! Bayern Munich 2, Borussia Dortmund 2. Fábio Silva (Borussia Dortmund) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Konstantinos Karetsas following a corner.Goal confirmed following VAR Review.
